document.adaptation: The Spanish original dropped; the English translation, introduced by its author's name, rewritten as an inline quote with a cue added (“wrote”).
document.text: The nuns also received dozens of messages on their Facebook page [es] criticising their decision. Although at the time this article was written these messages had been erased, you could still read some on the event's Facebook page [es]. Amalia López [es] wrote: “Saint Francis must be happy with these ladies.”
